lines.speaker: Child
lines.text: Lady Frieda, why do you tell us stories when you're tired?

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: Because you need them more than i need sleep.

lines.speaker: Child
lines.text: Do you think we'll ever be safe?

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: Yes sweetheart. One day. And when that day comes... i want to build a home where fear doesn't reach you.

lines.speaker: Child
lines.text: Does a place like that actually exist?

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text: So, she really cared for the children at the camp... enough to dream of giving them a future.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text: This isn't the past of a cruel woman. There's more to Frieda than the rumours.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text: Now that i know more about her, i should go look for her... she has to be here somewhere.
